description: 2D numerical wave tank (regression case cfd_2d_nwt run for 24 s): 2nd-order Stokes waves H = 0.02 m, L = 4 m in 0.5 m depth (T ~ 1.98 s), relaxation generation (0-4 m) and absorption (last 8 m). Wave height at the gauges x = 6, 8, 10 m over the last three periods (t = 18-24 s) against the target height: measures generation and propagation (numerical damping on this coarse grid, dx = L/80).
